Pilot (classes-18, 2 starts per class, 300,000 turns, every cell's evidence retained: messages, town transactions,
return events): the gate is that no cell has a config_error and every game ends in death, at the cap, or is reported
unfinished with its stop message. Everything is directional; a claim needs a fresh seed block (RULES 14). Primary
measures, fixed here, each per arm and class: (1) stocked: the share of town departures after the first that carry no
Word of Recall, and that carry 5 or fewer Phase Doors; (2) progress: mean max CL and depth, and alive at the cap, with
rescued / newly killed pairs against ctl; (3) why progress differs, if it does: the turns spent in town and in
DL1-town bounces, the gold at each purchase and what each visit bought (first visit, first three visits), and the
deaths before CL5 by cause; (4) situations covered at departure (Detect Invisible, Remove Curse, a poison cure, a
confusion cure, a fear remedy) and the staples' stack sizes against their free counts.
